profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at PayPal
profile.summary:
Currently working as a Staff Software Engineer at PayPal on the new v6 JS SDK team. Have been programming since middle school, and have a strong passion for technology and learning. Primary experience lies in designing, implementing, and maintaining large scale full stack enterprise applications. 

Graduated in 2018 from Washington University in St. Louis after completing a 4 year combined BS/MS degree in Computer Science

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Core team member working on the new v6 JS SDK

Scaled SDK from 0->1 with one of PayPal's largest partners

Led multiple internal AI R&D projects

Significant contributions to PayPal and Venmo buttons

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led full stack project to build new client facing Dashboard, working daily with our designer 

Owned and maintained suite of embeddable UI components allowing users to connect their liabilities

Built out robust monitoring and alerting to ensure KPIs are met and system regressions are quickly identified/triaged

Responded daily to customer issues and requests, providing direct support for the components of our application that I owned
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Next.js · React · NestJS · MongoDB · JavaScript · Node.js · Express.js

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led cross-team effort to build out new notification preference center, leveraging Typescript + Angular and Lambda (Python) + DynamoDB. 

Led complex 10x scalability research and testing of critical transaction processing batch jobs.

Worked closely with business partners to improve user analytics and insights by setting up and integrating third party tool WalkMe

Code owner of our UIs, reviewing and providing feedback to other engineers

As senior engineer on the team, significant portion of time spent coordinating with business/design/product partners, and mentoring Junior engineers within and outside of the team

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Our team owned and managed a Java spring boot microservice based audit logging framework for a B2B virtual card payment application

Worked extensively on migrating our application frontend from AngularJS to Angular/Typescript; migrated essential pages such as Login, Pay Capital One, Register User, Transactions, and Manage Bank Accounts.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and DevOps focused team, providing support for other teams within Cybersecurity

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked in an agile team to develop an internal application that aimed to allow associates to easily build and distribute Apps within the company.

positions.title: Developer Intern
positions.description:
Worked in an agile team to test a project management web app for a client by writing and executing test cases

Created a proof of concept for test case automation using Java with Selenium

Created a variety of excel macros that improved efficiency of data entry and formatting by 60% for a client

positions.title: Developer Intern
positions.description:
Worked with another intern to design a variety of VBA macros to assist in optimizing workflow within the recruitment team. 

   Created a resume formatting macro and a macro that highlighted specific search terms within resumes

   Tested a mobile app using DeviceAnywhere for a client
